summary: The microcontroller has a supply pin with no local decoupling capacitor to ground, risking brownout resets and switching noise. The rule engine confirms 8 finding(s).

confirmed_findings.title: Regulator missing input capacitor
confirmed_findings.detail: Regulator U2 (AMS1117-3.3) has no capacitor on its input net '+5V'. Most regulators oscillate or overshoot without it.
evidence: no capacitor attached to input net

confirmed_findings.title: Regulator missing output capacitor
confirmed_findings.detail: Regulator U2 (AMS1117-3.3) has no capacitor on its output net '+3V3'. Most regulators oscillate or overshoot without it.
evidence: no capacitor attached to output net

confirmed_findings.title: IC without decoupling capacitor
confirmed_findings.detail: IC U1 (ATmega328P) has supply pins without any decoupling capacitor to ground: pin 7 (+3V3)
evidence: supply pin on '+3V3' with no cap-to-ground on that rail

confirmed_findings.title: Net with only one connected pin
confirmed_findings.detail: Net '+5V' connects only U2.3. Check for a typo in a label or a missing wire.

recommendations.title: Fix for COMP-011
